posts.text: Day 1 of 12 to the vote. Two things from today: VBC covered the Kessa-North highway opening, and Kito TV's debate pressed both candidates on costings. Worth reading the full debate transcript before deciding. Election observers will publish procedure reminders this week.

Saw the Kessa-North highway opening on VBC today. Good roads mean my delivery trucks stop getting stuck in mud. Also watched the debate on Kito TV. Costings matter, whoever wins. Measure twice, cut once, as my late father said.

Ostrand cut a ribbon on a highway, Arden promised 200k jobs, and the debate moderators asked both how they'd pay for it. Guess which one actually got grilled on the numbers. Still undecided, still tired.

Stuck in Kessa traffic all morning and the new highway isn't even open yet lol. Ostrand's road better be worth the detour. Watching the debate tonight, Mara actually had numbers for once. #VeloriaVotes
Fuel up 40% under Ostrand? Tell that to me at the pump. Every week my diesel bill eats another slice of the harvest. Need the official price data before I vote, not just a slogan. #VeloriaVotes
Before anyone shares a screenshot of a party page claiming 'DOUBLE VAT', check the actual plan document first. Measure twice, cut once. Food prices hit my shop directly, so I want the real numbers.
VeriCheck has the Arden VAT and fuel-price claims rated false and misleading. Worth reading their full write-up before sharing either side's numbers.
Day 2 of the countdown and Kessa traffic is already brutal. Taxi meter running, patience not. Still waiting on that highway to actually open before I hand Mara any praise. #VeloriaVotes

Read the VeriCheck note on the fuel claim. A peak month isn't a trend, and the 2% of GDP gap estimate deserves a proper look from both camps before anyone votes on it. Measure twice, as my late father said.
Two weeks to the vote and I'm still undecided. Ostrand gets a highway ribbon, Arden gets 200k jobs, and somehow only one of them got grilled on the math. Make it make sense, Veloria. #VeloriaVotes

VBC plays a 'recording' of Arden and says 'questions raised' like that's a finding? Where's the chain of custody, who provided it, and has anyone verified it? Play the whole clip, sure, but a clip isn't evidence. #VeloriaVotes

Day 3 of 10 to the vote. VBC is reporting on a recording said to feature Mr Arden, and the Civic Front says it isn't genuine. Before sharing the clip or the denial, check whether anyone has verified the audio: source, date, and whether an independent fact-checker has looked at it. Observers will track this.

Day 4 of 9 to the vote. The Patriots Daily claim that Arden's running mate has a foreign passport and will sell the port: before sharing, check the source, any official candidate filings, and whether VeriCheck or another fact-checker has looked at it. Same standard for the Kito TV poll: 46 vs 44 with ±3 is a statistical tie, so read the methodology and sample size, not just the headline. #VeloriaV

Passport claim on the Arden running mate is a huge accusation to drop with zero sourcing in the article. Who's the source? Has anyone seen the passport? Before I get angry, I want to know if this is real. #VeloriaVotes
Poll says Mara 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided. Margin's ±3 so that's basically a coin toss lol. Undecideds, the next 9 days are yours. Watching Kessa traffic and the numbers like a hawk. #VeloriaVotes

Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10 undecided, margin ±3. That's a dead heat. Before anyone celebrates or panics, wait for more polls and read the methodology. Measure twice, as my late father said. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, 8 to go. #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs both trending, and researchers say the accounts behind them were made this month and post near-identical lines. Check who's posting before you repeat either tag. Commission's VeloResults test is open to observers, worth a look.
Two hashtags trending, dozens of accounts made this month posting near-identical text in minutes. Cool cool, very organic. Who's paying for the bot farm? Still undecided, still tired. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, eight days out, and my ward is short-staffed again. Health funding is the thing I actually lie awake over. Before I trust any #ArdenWillSellUs or #OstrandFailedUs post, I'm checking who wrote it and when. Lots of brand-new accounts all saying the same thing. Odd, no?

Day 5, 8 to the vote. Two things to check before you share: that WhatsApp 'community ambassador' message paying 2,000 vel to sign up and 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity. Who's paying, and why by polling station? Ask first. Also, the commission says results forms will be on VeloResults. Watch it, not the forwards. Measure twice.

Day 5 of 8 to the vote. The Commission says polling-station forms will be scanned and posted to the public VeloResults portal, and observers are invited to a system test. Good. Worth attending or reading the test notes before trusting any early results screenshot. Check the official source first.

Ambassador sign-ups paid per vote on WhatsApp? 2,000 vel to join, 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity. Who's paying, and is this even legal? Before anyone takes the bot link, check the Commission. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5 of the countdown. Saw the 'community ambassador' bot link going round WhatsApp: 2,000 vel to sign up, 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity? Paying people per vote is not a campaign, it's a red flag. Check who's behind it before you click. Also: the Commission is publishing how results get scanned and uploaded to VeloResults. Read that, not the screenshots. #VeloriaVotes

Read the VeloResults procedure notice. Scan, upload, public portal, observer test. Good. Now the test is what matters: can anyone outside the Commission reproduce a sample of uploaded forms against the paper originals? Measure twice, as my late father said. #VeloriaVotes

Two things I'd check before sharing today: that 'official' IECV letter about 212 Northern polling stations moving. Confirm it on the IECV site before you go. And the Kito TV clip of Ostrand's town-name slip is a slip, not a policy. Sources first. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, seven to go, and I'm still on shift. Before anyone shares that 'OFFICIAL' letter about 212 polling stations moving, check the IECV site yourself. Forwarded PDFs aren't notices. Please, check first. #VeloriaVotes

Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a provincial town. Slip of the tongue, sure. Judge the policy record, not the pronunciation. Still want to see the fuel and VAT numbers from the official source before I decide. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 to go. Got a 'OFFICIAL LETTER' on WhatsApp saying 212 Northern polling stations are moving. Don't forward it. Check the IECV site or the Commission's own notice first. Measure twice. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 to the vote. Kito TV clip: Ostrand mispronounces a provincial town and her team calls it 'a slip of the tongue'. Maybe. Check the full clip, not the 10-second loop, before deciding what it means. #VeloriaVotes

Mara's team calls mispronouncing a town name 'a slip of the tongue'. Cool. Meanwhile I'm still waiting for someone to explain the fuel price numbers without a slogan attached. Two weeks, Veloria, give me something real. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 to go. That 'IECV letter' moving 212 Northern polling stations? Don't forward it, check iecv.gov.vl or the Commission's own feed first. Moved stations get announced officially, not by WhatsApp chain. Wait for the Commission, not the forward. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. The forward saying 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' is exactly the kind of message to check before acting on. Vote, or check the IECV notice on where your station is. Don't let a voice note decide for you. Measure twice. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight per the IECV. Reminder: the 212-station 'OFFICIAL' letter is still unverified. Don't forward it. Check iecv.gov.vl before sharing anything about polling locations. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight, so no more rallies or hot takes from parties. Quiet time, and the bot-farm stuff needs to be off my feed too. Check the official IECV notice, not the WhatsApp voice notes. Vote on the 19th. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight and Chirp is still full of Zuri K clips. Cool, nothing like a singer's endorsement to fix the fuel price question. Still undecided, still tired. Give me numbers, not vibes. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls open. Turnout looks high. Some ID kits failed in the Northern Province, and officials switched to the printed register as the law allows. Don't trust screenshots of results: follow the Commission's VeloResults portal and the official notices. Measure twice. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria! Polls are open. Ignore the WhatsApp 'ballot box' photo until the Commission confirms it. Results will come from VeloResults, not forwards. Vote, then check the official feed. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, election day. The Commission says polls are open and some ID kits failed in the north, so they switched to the printed register as the law allows. Those are facts from the official source. Those 'pre-stuffed ballot box' photos going round WhatsApp? No source, no date, no location I can check. Don't share them. Go vote, and check results on VeloResults, not forwards. Measure twice. #VeloriaV

Day 8, polls open. Northern stations switched to the printed register, that's legal per the Commission. Before you share any 'pre-stuffed boxes' photo, find the official report. Forwards aren't evidence. Vote, then check VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria and the Commission says voter-ID kits failed up north, so they switched to the printed register. Cool, nothing says 'trust the process' like plan B on the big day. Still undecided, still tired. Let's see if VeloResults actually shows up. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and two 'results' are already fighting: Kito TV says Arden, VBC says Ostrand, and some random account is posting 'FINAL RESULTS' like it's Tuesday already. Counting is still going. Wait for VeloResults, not vibes. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Kito TV's tally (30% of stations: Arden 51%) and VBC's (25%: Ostrand 53%) count different stations first, so neither tells us who's winning yet. Wait for VeloResults and the Commission's scanned forms before reading anything into it. Measure twice. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two tallies from Kito TV and VBC, different station counts, opposite leaders. Neither is a result yet. Wait for VeloResults and the Commission. Don't trust a single screenshot. Measure twice. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two stations counts, both showing different winners: Kito's 51-47 Arden, VBC's 53-45 Ostrand. Different samples, so neither means anything yet. Wait for VeloResults and the Commission. Don't screenshot a number and call it a result. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Kito says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Different stations counted first, so neither tally settles it. Civic Front says 'Arden WON' from party agent tallies. That's a claim, not a result. Wait for VeloResults and the Commission. Measure twice. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. Portal still only has 41% of station forms, and the Commission says collation is manual. The '9 of 14 provinces' claim from Patriots Daily is false per VeriCheck, so don't share it. Wait for VeloResults and the scanned forms. Measure twice. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. Still no VeloResults, only 41% of forms online and the Commission says 'technical glitch'. Kito's tally and VBC's tally count different stations, so neither tells us who won. Party agent 'Arden WON' claims aren't results either. Wait for the Commission's scanned forms. Measure twice. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. Still no VeloResults for most stations, and the Commission says 41% of forms are online. Kito's Arden lead and VBC's Ostrand lead come from different sample stations, so neither is a result. Don't screenshot a number and call it a winner. Wait for the official count. Measure twice. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. VeloResults still half-dead, 41% of forms up, and VeloriaPatriots is screaming 'PROVES Arden won 9 of 14!' with zero link to the actual data. Different stations, different tallies, cool. Wait for the Commission, not a headline with a vibe.

Day 11. IECV declares Ostrand re-elected 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers flag skewed state coverage and transmission delays, so read the official count closely. Check the Commission's scanned forms and VeloResults, and be wary of any 'stolen' or 'rigged' screenshots. Measure twice. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Official result, so I'm taking it as the count. Whatever you voted, the Commission has spoken. Now let's see what the next four years look like. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6 to 47.9, turnout 68%. Fine, official result. Still want the scanned forms on VeloResults before I trust anyone's 'we won' claim, but at least there's a number from the Commission now. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. Commission declares Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official result. Disagree with it if you like, but take it to the courts or the next vote, not the forwards. Congrats to Mara's team, and I hope Tomas's side accepts it like adults. Measure twice, then get back to the shop. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. 50.6 to 47.9 is the Commission's count, but I'm still waiting for the scanned forms before I call anything settled. Tired nurse, not a pundit. Who's staffing the wards after this? #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito and VBC are fighting over 'riots' and 'petitions' while I'm still waiting on the scanned forms. 50.6 vs 47.9 is the Commission's number. Court access to the servers is the right move, so let the judges read the logs. Measure twice. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. VBC shows burning tyres in Kessa and calls it 'opposition riots.' Kito says the Supreme Court ordered supervised server access for both sides. Footage without a time or source doesn't tell me who started what. Wait for the court record. Measure twice. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Two different stories from the same day: VBC's riot footage from Kessa, and Kito TV says the Supreme Court ordered supervised access to the Commission's servers and logs. Neither tells me the count was wrong. Court access is the right lane. Wait for the scanned forms and the court's outcome before deciding anything. Measure twice. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito says the Supreme Court is making the Commission open its servers and logs to both sides. VBC shows burning tyres in Kessa and calls it 'riots'. Cool, I want the court's order and the logs before I believe either version. Measure twice. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito's petition is the right move: the Court wants supervised access to the servers and logs, and that's how we'll know what actually happened. VBC's Kessa 'riot' footage has no date or location I can check, so I'm not sharing it. Let the audit run. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito and VBC are both pushing 'riot' and 'stolen' stories, and neither has a source I can check. Court-ordered server access is the thing to watch. Wait for what the audit actually finds. #VeloriaVotes
